elements_selected.content: Implement dual hashing for SplBlock leaves per §4.4. For each SplBlock leaf: 1) content_hash = BLAKE3(normalised_raw_spl_text) — normalise whitespace and strip SPL comments (;; comment lines), 2) ast_hash = BLAKE3(canonically_serialised_spl_ast) where canonical serialisation means rules sorted by label, facts sorted by literal, superiority sorted by pair. Use spindle-parser to parse the SPL text; if parsing fails, ast_hash = [0u8; 32] (sentinel) and emit a diagnostic. The combined SplBlock leaf hash = BLAKE3(content_hash_bytes ‖ ast_hash_bytes) feeds into the file Merkle root. Implement this in the reason feature gate (#[cfg(feature = "reason")]) since it requires spindle-parser. When the reason feature is off, fall back to content_hash only for both content_hash and ast_hash. Store SplLeafHash { content_hash, ast_hash } in SplLeafCached. Expose compute_spl_hashes(content: &str) -> Result<SplLeafHash> as a testable function.
